007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.Session;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ConversationAttributes;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
016import org.slf4j.Logger;
017import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
018
019/**
020 * Sample for calling Profile#chatSession(Conversation, boolean).
021 *
022 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
023 * {@link Profile}, configure a {@link Conversation}, start a context-aware
024 * {@link Session}, and run two chat prompts that share the same conversation
025 * ID.</p>
026 *
027 * <p>This sample changes database state by creating a conversation. Set
028 * {@code SELECTAI_SESSION_DELETE_ON_CLOSE=true} to drop the conversation when
029 * the session closes.</p>
030 *
031 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
032 * <ul>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
040 * <ul>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_TITLE - defaults to a sample title.</li>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DESCRIPTION - defaults to a sample description.</li>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS - defaults to {@code 7}.</li>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_LENGTH - defaults to {@code 20}.</li>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_SESSION_PROMPT_1 - defaults to a sample first prompt.</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_SESSION_PROMPT_2 - defaults to a sample follow-up prompt.</li>
047 *   <li>SELECTAI_SESSION_DELETE_ON_CLOSE - defaults to {@code false}.</li>
048 * </ul>
049 *
050 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
051 * <pre>{@code
052 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
053 * }</pre>
054 *
055 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
056 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
057 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
058 * <pre>{@code
059 * mvn clean install
060 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
061 * }</pre>
062 *
063 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
064 * <pre>{@code
065 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
066 *   -d samples/out \
067 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/ChatSessionProfileSample.java
068 * }</pre>
069 *
070 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
071 * <pre>{@code
072 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
073 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.ChatSessionProfileSample
074 * }</pre>
075 *
076 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
077 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
078 * and diagnostics.</p>
079 */
080public final class ChatSessionProfileSample {
081    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ChatSessionProfileSample.class);
082
083    private ChatSessionProfileSample() {
084    }
085
086    public static void main(String[] args) {
087        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
088        String firstPrompt = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_SESSION_PROMPT_1",
089                "What is the importance of history of science?");
090        String secondPrompt = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_SESSION_PROMPT_2",
091                "Elaborate more on learning from past mistakes.");
092        boolean deleteOnClose = Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_SESSION_DELETE_ON_CLOSE", "false"));
093
094        try {
095            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
096            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName);
097            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(buildConversationAttributes());
098
099            try (Session session = profile.chatSession(conversation, deleteOnClose)) {
100                System.out.printf("Conversation ID: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(conversation.getConversationId()));
101                System.out.printf("First chat response:%n%s%n", valueOrEmpty(session.chat(firstPrompt)));
102                System.out.printf("Follow-up chat response:%n%s%n", valueOrEmpty(session.chat(secondPrompt)));
103            }
104        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
105            LOGGER.error("Failed to run chat session for Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
106        }
107    }
108
109    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
110        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
111                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
112                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
113                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
114                .build();
115
116        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
117    }
118
119    private static ConversationAttributes buildConversationAttributes() {
120        return ConversationAttributes.builder()
121                .title(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_TITLE", "Java SDK Chat Session"))
122                .description(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DESCRIPTION",
123                        "Conversation created by the Java Select AI SDK chat session sample."))
124                .retentionDays(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS", "7")))
125                .conversationLength(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_LENGTH", "20")))
126                .build();
127    }
128
129    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
130        String value = System.getenv(name);
131        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
132            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
133        }
134        return value;
135    }
136
137    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
138        String value = System.getenv(name);
139        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
140    }
141
142    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
143        return value == null ? "" : value;
144    }
145}
